placements.text: Jupiter is in the 2nd house (Dhana bhav) in Virgo. This house covers wealth, savings, family, speech, food, early education. It is a maraka house (2/7) – houses that can bring health strain in difficult periods. Jupiter is in an enemy's sign – uncomfortable, results come with friction. For your Leo ascendant it rules houses 5 & 8 (children; longevity), so those matters are carried into the 2nd house. It is mixed for this ascendant (rules good and difficult houses). Conjunct (yuti) with Saturn. Aspected by Ketu. It aspects houses 6, 8, 10. Nakshatra Hasta (pada 2, ruled by Moon).

placements.text: Saturn is in the 2nd house (Dhana bhav) in Virgo. This house covers wealth, savings, family, speech, food, early education. It is a maraka house (2/7) – houses that can bring health strain in difficult periods. Saturn is in a friend's sign – supported, gives fair results. For your Leo ascendant it rules houses 6 & 7 (enemies; marriage), so those matters are carried into the 2nd house. It is a functional malefic for this ascendant (rules 3/6/8/11). Conjunct (yuti) with Jupiter. Aspected by Ketu. It aspects houses 4, 8, 11. Nakshatra Hasta (pada 2, ruled by Moon).

placements.house_meaning: expenses, losses, sleep, foreign lands, hospitals, isolation, moksha
placements.text: Rahu is in the 12th house (Vyaya bhav) in Cancer. This house covers expenses, losses, sleep, foreign lands, hospitals, isolation, moksha. It is a dusthana (6/8/12) – houses of struggle; planets here face obstacles or turn their energy to fighting problems. It is a shadow planet – gives the results of its sign lord and companions. Aspected by Mars, Ketu. It aspects houses 4, 6, 8. Nakshatra Ashlesha (pada 1, ruled by Mercury).

placements.house_meaning: enemies, disease, debts, disputes, litigation, service, daily work
placements.text: Ketu is in the 6th house (Ripu bhav) in Capricorn. This house covers enemies, disease, debts, disputes, litigation, service, daily work. It is a dusthana (6/8/12) – houses of struggle; planets here face obstacles or turn their energy to fighting problems; also an upachaya (3/6/10/11) – houses of growth; malefics improve here with time and effort. It is a shadow planet – gives the results of its sign lord and companions. Conjunct (yuti) with Mars. Aspected by Jupiter, Rahu. It aspects houses 2, 10, 12. Nakshatra Shravana (pada 3, ruled by Moon).

placements.text: Mercury is in the 5th house (Putra bhav) in Sagittarius. This house covers children, intelligence, learning, mantra, creativity, past-life merit, speculation. It is a trikona (trine: 1/5/9) – the most auspicious houses, of merit and luck. Mercury is in a neutral sign – average results. For your Leo ascendant it rules houses 2 & 11 (wealth; gains), so those matters are carried into the 5th house. It is a functional malefic for this ascendant (rules 3/6/8/11). Conjunct (yuti) with Sun. It aspects house 11. Combust – overpowered by the Sun, so its significations are weakened. Nakshatra Mula (pada 4, ruled by Ketu).
